title: Intern, Exterior Design, Summer 2027
note: Automotive exterior design internship for students currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program; visa sponsorship is not guaranteed.

facts.duties: Works with the exterior design team on design development, autonomous mobility concepts and future products, and joins design meetings and reviews with senior leadership.
facts.requirements: Currently enrolled Bachelor's or Master's student; hand sketching and Photoshop, some Alias and Blender; Vizcom preferred. Housing and transport are the intern's responsibility; relocation help is case by case.
facts.apply: Apply on the Lucid careers posting.
